cases.title: Findings: Social media post
cases.text:
The league has finished its investigation of Nakia Langston (DL, Rovers) (opened in week 1).

THE REVIEW. Investigators went through Nakia Langston's public accounts back to the start of training camp and found 4 earlier posts mocking opposing fans, 2 of them aimed at Rapids supporters. 3 were deleted after the viral video drew attention. None of the posts threatened anyone or used slurs; the league's concern is the pattern, which its social media policy treats separately from a single video.

THE CLUB. The Rovers cooperated, said they had not seen the earlier posts, and have asked Nakia Langston to stop posting about opposing fans.

RECORD. Nakia Langston has no earlier cases on the desk.

WHERE THINGS STAND. Your ruling at the time was no action, with a request to investigate. The video was removed and Nakia Langston apologized in a follow-up post.

cases.title: Late hit
cases.where: Classetto Cavemen at Verigon Komodos, week 3
cases.text:
Officials flagged Padma Devacharya (LB, Komodos) for roughing the passer with 9:02 left in the second quarter; replays show the contact landed after the whistle. Film review showed the contact was close to the whistle.

Officials in the game, led by Petra Hollowell, reported the play to the league.

cases.title: Public criticism of a crew
cases.where: Tasson Thunderbugs at El Latigo Shredders, week 3
cases.text:
Lakshman Ganguly (WR, Thunderbugs) said in a postgame interview that the officials 'should be ashamed'.

The players' union says it is reviewing the remarks.
